newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Oct manufacturing hiring up 5.5 pct - gov't.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Oct manufacturing hiring up 5.5 pct - gov't.

text.p: Mexico's manufacturing sector hired an additional 5.5 percent in October over the same month in 1995, the National Statistics Institute (INEGI) said in a statement Monday.
INEGI said the increase marks the seventh consecutive month in which employment grew in the sector, and the largest increase for the year.

Among the largest employment growth, metal, machinery and equipment production grew 11 percent, textile production grew 10.6 percent, wood production grew 6.3 percent and basic metals production grew 5.9 percent, the government agency said.
Hours worked during the month grew 8.2 percent from the same month the year before, INEGI said.
In the metal and machinery production sector, hours worked increased by 17.2 percent, in textiles 15.5 percent, in woodwork 10.4 percent and in basic metals 8.8 percent.

Employment in food and tobacco production grew a smaller 1.2 percent with a 1.5 percent increase in hours worked. The work force in petroleum by-product production grew 4.7 percent and hours worked increased 7.7 percent. Paper and printing employment fell 0.2 percent and hours worked grew 0.3 percent.
